if obs:
    ints = list(map(int, obs))
    print('lengths', sorted(set(map(len, obs))))
    print('isdigit', sorted(set(o.isdigit() for o in obs)))
    print('first', sorted(set(o[0] for o in obs)))
    print('mean', round(sum(ints)/len(ints), 2))
